jobs.description:
Overview
 With over 17,000 employees worldwide, the mission of the Customer Experience & Success (CE&S) organization is to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. Come join CE&S and help us build a future where customers achieve their business outcomes faster with technology that does more.
 Imagine helping some of Switzerland's leading organizations change how work gets done, with an impact that reaches across industries, communities and lives worldwide. As a Cloud Solution Architect for Copilot and Agents, you will do exactly that with Microsoft 365 Copilot, agents and artificial intelligence.
 You will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to turn modern cloud and AI capabilities into real-world scenarios that drive innovation and measurable value. Your role sits where strategy meets execution. You will shape how customers adopt, scale and govern AI as part of their digital transformation.
 You will combine your understanding of customer goals, market trends and Microsoft cloud architectures to guide organizations from first experiments to lasting transformation. You will help customers:

• Find the use cases that matter most

• Design adoption approaches that work for their people

• Remove the blockers that slow them down
 The result is measurable productivity gains and better business outcomes.
 Your impact goes beyond a single engagement. You will work across Microsoft and bring customer feedback to the product teams that shape the platform. You will also contribute to best-practice guidance and reusable patterns that help many more customers succeed.
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

• Focus on customer and partner experience through efficient delivery, ensuring a seamless and connected engagement that supports value realization, improved satisfaction, and acceleration of transformation.

• Act as the voice of the customer by sharing feedback, insights, success stories, and strategic or technical input with internal teams, and contribute to identifying patterns across customers or industries that inform actionable insights and product improvements.

• Contribute to identifying, escalating, and mitigating technical and business blockers using appropriate tools and processes to accelerate solution deployment, usage, and business outcome realization.

• Help customers adopt and use solutions aligned with Microsoft product and platform strategy by translating business problems into industry solutions, explaining the business value and return on investment.

• Collaborate across Microsoft and customer or partner teams to deliver on-strategy engagements, manage business and technical risks in line with governance principles, and ensure work complies with industry and Microsoft guidelines and procedures.

Qualifications
 Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience
• OR equivalent experience

• As this role will involve collaboration with local customers, fluency in German is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field AND solid experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting
• OR equivalent experience

• Solid experience working in a customer-facing role (e.g., internal and/or external)

• Solid experience working on technical projects

• Technical Certification in Cloud (e.g., Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google, security certifications)

• Fluency in French

Panoramica
Con oltre 17.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo, la missione dell'organizzazione Customer Experience & Success (CE&S) è quella di consentire ai clienti di accelerare il valore aziendale attraverso esperienze di cliente differenziate che sfruttano i prodotti e i servizi di Microsoft, accesi dalla nostra gente e cultura. Unisciti a CE&S e aiutaci a costruire un futuro in cui i clienti raggiungono i loro risultati aziendali più velocemente con la tecnologia che fa di più.
Immaginate di aiutare alcune delle principali organizzazioni della Svizzera a cambiare il modo in cui il lavoro viene fatto, con un impatto che raggiunge industrie, comunità e vite in tutto il mondo. Come Cloud Solution Architect per Copilot e Agenti, lo farai esattamente con Microsoft 365 Copilot, agenti e intelligenza artificiale.
Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder aziendali e tecnici per trasformare le moderne funzionalità cloud e AI in scenari reali che guidano l'innovazione e il valore misurabile. Il tuo ruolo si trova dove la strategia incontra l'esecuzione. Potrai modellare come i clienti adottano, scalano e governano l'IA come parte della loro trasformazione digitale.
Potrai combinare la tua comprensione degli obiettivi del cliente, le tendenze del mercato e le architetture cloud Microsoft per guidare le organizzazioni dai primi esperimenti alla trasformazione duratura. Aiuterai i clienti:

• Trovare i casi di utilizzo più importanti

• L'adozione del design si avvicina al lavoro per le loro persone

• Rimuovere i bloccanti che rallentano
Il risultato è guadagni di produttività misurabili e migliori risultati aziendali.
Il tuo impatto va oltre un solo impegno. Potrai lavorare in Microsoft e portare il feedback dei clienti ai team di prodotto che modellano la piattaforma. Contribuirai anche alla guida best-practice e modelli riutilizzabili che aiutano molti più clienti a riuscire.
La missione di Microsoft è di consentire a ogni persona e ogni organizzazione del pianeta di ottenere di più. Come dipendenti ci uniamo con una mentalità di crescita, innovare per potenziare gli altri, e collaborare per realizzare i nostri obiettivi condivisi. Ogni giorno costruiamo sui nostri valori di rispetto, integrità e responsabilità per creare una cultura di inclusione dove tutti possono prosperare al lavoro e oltre.

responsabilità

• Concentrati sull'esperienza del cliente e del partner attraverso una consegna efficiente, assicurando un impegno senza soluzione di continuità e connesso che supporta la realizzazione del valore, la soddisfazione migliorata e l'accelerazione della trasformazione.

• Agire come voce del cliente condividendo feedback, intuizioni, storie di successo e input strategico o tecnico con i team interni, e contribuire a identificare i modelli tra clienti o industrie che informano intuizioni attuabili e miglioramenti del prodotto.

• Contribuisci all'identificazione, all'escalation e alla mitigazione dei bloccanti tecnici e aziendali utilizzando strumenti e processi appropriati per accelerare la realizzazione di soluzioni, utilizzo e risultati aziendali.

• Aiuta i clienti ad adottare e utilizzare soluzioni allineate con la strategia di prodotto e piattaforma Microsoft traducendo i problemi aziendali nelle soluzioni del settore, spiegando il valore aziendale e il ritorno sugli investimenti.

• Collabora tra team Microsoft e clienti o partner per fornire impegni on-strategy, gestire i rischi aziendali e tecnici in linea con i principi di governance, e garantire il lavoro conforme alle linee guida e procedure di settore e Microsoft.

• O esperienza equivalente

• Poiché questo ruolo coinvolgerà la collaborazione con i clienti locali, è necessaria una fluidità in tedesco.

Preferiti:

• Laurea Magistrale in Informatica, Informatica, Ingegneria, Business, o relativo campo E solida esperienza nelle tecnologie cloud/infrastruttura, tecnologia dell'informazione (IT) consulenza/supporto, amministrazione di sistemi, operazioni di rete, sviluppo/supporto software, soluzioni tecnologiche, sviluppo pratica, architettura e/o consulenza
• O esperienza equivalente

• Esperienza solida che lavora in un ruolo di cliente (ad esempio, interno e/o esterno)

• Solida esperienza di lavoro per progetti tecnici

• Certificazione tecnica in Cloud (ad esempio, Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google, certificazioni di sicurezza)

• Fluenza in francese

Übersicht
Mit über 17.000 Mitarbeitern weltweit ist es die Mission der Customer Experience & Success (CE&S)-Organisation, Kunden in die Lage zu versetzen, den Geschäftswert durch differenzierte Kundenerfahrungen zu steigern, die die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Microsoft nutzen, die von unseren Mitarbeitern und unserer Kultur inspiriert werden. Kommen Sie zu CE&S und helfen Sie uns, eine Zukunft aufzubauen, in der Kunden ihre Geschäftsergebnisse schneller mit Technologien erzielen, die mehr leisten.
Stellen Sie sich vor, Sie könnten einigen der führenden Schweizer Organisationen helfen, die Art und Weise, wie Arbeit erledigt wird, zu verändern, mit einer Wirkung, die Branchen, Gemeinschaften und das Leben weltweit erreicht. Als Cloud Solution Architect für Copilot und Agenten machen Sie genau das mit Microsoft 365 Copilot, Agenten und künstlicher Intelligenz.
Sie arbeiten eng mit geschäftlichen und technischen Stakeholdern zusammen, um moderne Cloud- und KI-Fähigkeiten in reale Szenarien zu verwandeln, die Innovationen und messbaren Wert fördern. Ihre Rolle liegt dort, wo Strategie auf Ausführung trifft. Sie gestalten, wie Kunden KI im Rahmen ihrer digitalen Transformation übernehmen, skalieren und steuern.
Sie kombinieren Ihr Verständnis von Kundenzielen, Markttrends und Microsoft-Cloud-Architekturen, um Unternehmen von ersten Experimenten bis hin zu einer nachhaltigen Transformation zu führen. Sie helfen Kunden:

• Finden Sie die Anwendungsfälle, die am wichtigsten sind

• Design Adoption Ansätze, die für ihre Menschen arbeiten

• Entfernen Sie die Blocker, die sie verlangsamen
Das Ergebnis sind messbare Produktivitätsgewinne und bessere Geschäftsergebnisse.
Ihre Wirkung geht über ein einzelnes Engagement hinaus. Sie arbeiten über Microsoft und bringen Kundenfeedback zu den Produktteams, die die Plattform formen. Sie werden auch zu Best-Practice-Anleitungen und wiederverwendbaren Mustern beitragen, die vielen weiteren Kunden zum Erfolg verhelfen.
Microsofts Mission ist es, jede Person und jedes Unternehmen auf dem Planeten zu befähigen, mehr zu erreichen. Als Mitarbeiter kommen wir mit einer Wachstumsmentalität zusammen, innovieren, um andere zu stärken, und arbeiten zusammen, um unsere gemeinsamen Ziele zu erreichen. Jeden Tag bauen wir auf unseren Werten Respekt, Integrität und Rechenschaftspflicht auf, um eine Kultur der Inklusion zu schaffen, in der jeder bei der Arbeit und darüber hinaus gedeihen kann.

Zuständigkeiten

• Konzentrieren Sie sich auf die Kunden- und Partnererfahrung durch effiziente Lieferung und gewährleisten Sie ein nahtloses und vernetztes Engagement, das die Wertrealisierung, eine verbesserte Zufriedenheit und die Beschleunigung der Transformation unterstützt.

• Handeln Sie als die Stimme des Kunden, indem Sie Feedback, Erkenntnisse, Erfolgsgeschichten und strategische oder technische Beiträge mit internen Teams teilen und dazu beitragen, Muster für Kunden oder Branchen zu identifizieren, die zu umsetzbaren Erkenntnissen und Produktverbesserungen führen.

• Tragen Sie dazu bei, technische und geschäftliche Blocker zu identifizieren, zu eskalieren und zu mindern, indem Sie geeignete Tools und Prozesse verwenden, um die Bereitstellung, Nutzung und Realisierung von Geschäftsergebnissen zu beschleunigen.

• Helfen Sie Kunden, Lösungen zu übernehmen und zu verwenden, die auf die Microsoft-Produkt- und Plattformstrategie ausgerichtet sind, indem Sie Geschäftsprobleme in Branchenlösungen übersetzen und den Geschäftswert und den Return on Investment erklären.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Microsoft- und Kunden- oder Partnerteams zusammen, um On-Strategie-Engagements zu liefern, geschäftliche und technische Risiken im Einklang mit Governance-Prinzipien zu verwalten und sicherzustellen, dass die Arbeit den Richtlinien und Verfahren von Industrie und Microsoft entspricht.

Qualifikationen
Benötigte Qualifikationen:

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Informationstechnologie, Ingenieurwesen, Business oder verwandten Bereichen UND Erfahrung in Cloud / Infrastrukturtechnologien, Informationstechnologie (IT) Beratung / Support, Systemverwaltung, Netzwerkbetrieb, Softwareentwicklung / Support, Technologielösungen, Praxisentwicklung, Architektur und / oder Beratung ODER gleichwertige Erfahrung
• ODER gleichwertige Erfahrung

• Da diese Rolle die Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen Kunden beinhalten wird, ist fließend Deutsch erforderlich.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Master-Abschluss in Informatik, Informationstechnologie, Ingenieurwesen, Business oder verwandten Bereichen UND solide Erfahrung in Cloud / Infrastrukturtechnologien, Informationstechnologie (IT) Beratung / Support, Systemverwaltung, Netzwerkbetrieb, Softwareentwicklung / Support, Technologielösungen, Praxisentwicklung, Architektur und / oder Beratung

Aperçu général
Avec plus de 17 000 employés dans le monde, la mission de l'organisation Customer Experience & Success (CE&S) est de donner aux clients les moyens d'accélérer la valeur commerciale grâce à des expériences client différenciées qui tirent parti des produits et des services de Microsoft, enflammés par nos gens et notre culture. Venez nous rejoindre et nous aider à bâtir un avenir où les clients atteignent leurs résultats commerciaux plus rapidement grâce à une technologie qui fait plus.
Imaginez aider certaines des principales organisations suisses à changer la façon dont le travail se fait, avec un impact qui touche les industries, les communautés et la vie dans le monde entier. En tant qu'architecte Cloud Solution pour Copilot et Agents, vous ferez exactement cela avec Microsoft 365 Copilot, agents et intelligence artificielle.
Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants commerciaux et techniques pour transformer les capacités modernes de cloud et d'IA en scénarios réels qui stimulent l'innovation et la valeur mesurable. Votre rôle se situe là où la stratégie rencontre l'exécution. Vous façonnerez la façon dont les clients adoptent, mettent à l'échelle et gouvernent l'IA dans le cadre de leur transformation numérique.
Vous combinerez votre compréhension des objectifs clients, des tendances du marché et des architectures de cloud Microsoft pour guider les organisations des premières expériences à la transformation durable. Vous aiderez les clients:

• Trouver les cas d'utilisation qui comptent le plus

• Concevoir des approches d'adoption qui fonctionnent pour leur peuple

• Enlevez les bloqueurs qui les ralentissent
Il en résulte des gains de productivité mesurables et de meilleurs résultats opérationnels.
Votre impact va au-delà d'un seul engagement. Vous travaillerez sur Microsoft et apporterez les commentaires des clients aux équipes de produits qui façonnent la plateforme. Vous contribuerez également à l'orientation des meilleures pratiques et aux modèles réutilisables qui aident beaucoup plus de clients à réussir.
La mission de Microsoft est d'habiliter chaque personne et chaque organisation de la planète à réaliser davantage. En tant qu'employés, nous nous associons à une mentalité de croissance, innovons pour responsabiliser les autres et collaborons pour réaliser nos objectifs communs. Chaque jour, nous nous appuyons sur nos valeurs de respect, d'intégrité et de responsabilité pour créer une culture d'inclusion où chacun peut prospérer au travail et au-delà.

Responsabilités

• Concentrez-vous sur l'expérience client et partenaire grâce à une prestation efficace, assurant un engagement sans faille et connecté qui soutient la réalisation de valeur, une satisfaction améliorée et l'accélération de la transformation.

• Agir en tant que voix du client en partageant les commentaires, les idées, les exemples de réussite et les commentaires stratégiques ou techniques avec les équipes internes, et contribuer à l'identification des modèles parmi les clients ou les industries qui éclairent les idées pratiques et les améliorations de produits.

• Contribuer à l'identification, à l'escalade et à l'atténuation des obstacles techniques et commerciaux en utilisant des outils et des processus appropriés pour accélérer le déploiement, l'utilisation et la réalisation des résultats opérationnels.

• Aider les clients à adopter et à utiliser des solutions alignées sur la stratégie des produits et des plateformes Microsoft en traduisant les problèmes d'affaires en solutions industrielles, en expliquant la valeur commerciale et le rendement de l'investissement.

• Collaborer avec les équipes de Microsoft et les clients ou partenaires pour réaliser des engagements stratégiques, gérer les risques commerciaux et techniques conformément aux principes de gouvernance et s'assurer que le travail est conforme aux directives et procédures de l'industrie et de Microsoft.

• Baccalauréat en informatique, technologie de l'information, ingénierie, affaires ou domaine connexe ET expérience en technologies du cloud/infrastructure, conseil/soutien en technologie de l'information (TI), administration des systèmes, opérations de réseau, développement/soutien de logiciels, solutions technologiques, développement de pratiques, architecture et/ou expérience de consultation équivalente OU

jobs.description:
Overview
 Step into a role where your ideas spark innovation and your impact is felt every day. As a Senior Solution Area Specialist (Cloud and Artificial Intelligence), you will join a specialist sales team supporting Japan headquartered organizations with operations across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, primarily within industrial manufacturing and global communications and information technology team. You will partner closely with account teams to shape global account plans, orchestrate and influence senior level stakeholders, and focus efforts on an industry with significant growth potential.
 In this role, you will lead the Azure and artificial intelligence strategy across a defined portfolio of Japan Global Accounts. You will align Microsoft cloud and artificial intelligence solutions to senior customer decision makers’ strategic priorities, uncover new opportunities, and differentiate Microsoft in a competitive landscape. You will act as the lead orchestrator across the solution set, bringing together sellers and experts from multiple solution areas to deliver secure, outcome-focused transformations that matter to your customers’ businesses.
 Join the team to help create lasting customer impact and elevate execution across complex global accounts.
 At Microsoft, our mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth‑mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress, people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.
 Find out more about our culture and values , and the environment you will be working in.

Responsibilities
 Responsibilities

• Lead discussions with senior stakeholders and decision makers in high-value global accounts to identify, qualify, and accelerate complex Azure and artificial intelligence sales opportunities aligned to customer business priorities.

• Synthesize evaluation of the solution area and market to strategically align sales plays with customer outcomes, using market intelligence and predictive insights to guide sales strategy and execution across your portfolio.

• Lead cross-organizational partnerships to design and land cloud and artificial intelligence solutions, acting as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor who drives adoption and digital transformation for industrial manufacturing and communications customers.

• Guide sales pipeline reviews and forecasting with internal senior stakeholders, leveraging analytics to maintain pipeline hygiene, improve forecasting accuracy, and meet or exceed sales and consumption targets.

• Orchestrate partner teams and internal resources to drive co-selling motions, ensure seamless handoffs across account, customer success, and delivery teams, and foster long-term, secure customer relationships grounded in measurable business value.

Qualifications
 Qualifications

• Proven track record of directly selling technology solutions to enterprise customers and managing complex customer opportunities.

• Knowledge of enterprise cloud technologies, gained through selling solutions across Azure, AWS, Google Cloud or comparable cloud platforms.

• Practical application of AI technologies, with the ability to discuss AI solutions, use cases and opportunities with customers.

• Demonstrated success building relationships with senior executives and engaging C-level stakeholders on technology and business priorities.

• Ability to orchestrate complex enterprise opportunities, bringing together account teams, technical specialists and other stakeholders around a customer strategy.

• Background in competitive technology sales, including negotiating and positioning solutions against competing cloud or technology providers.

• Consultative and technical sales capability, translating customer requirements into relevant technology solutions.

Overview
 Shape the Future of AI. Transform Partners into Frontier Leaders. Scale Business Impact.
 Join Microsoft's high-performing Cloud & AI Partner Architects team in DACH and play a pivotal role in accelerating AI innovation and business transformation across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland through our strategic partner ecosystem.
 As a Senior Cloud Solution Architect - Data & AI , you will combine deep technical expertise, architectural leadership, and strategic business acumen to help our most influential partners design, build, and scale innovative AI-powered solutions. You will act as a trusted technical advisor, guiding partners through complex architectural decisions, solution development, and the adoption of Microsoft's latest cloud, data, and AI technologies.
 A key part of your mission is to accelerate the evolution of our partners into Frontier Partners -helping them move beyond traditional technology services and isolated AI experiments toward AI-first business models, intelligent agent-based solutions, differentiated intellectual property (IP), and scalable, repeatable offerings that deliver measurable customer outcomes.
 You will work closely with partner executives, technical leaders, engineering teams, and Microsoft sales organizations to shape AI transformation strategies, lead architectural design sessions, accelerate production-ready solutions, and unlock new market opportunities . By combining technical leadership with a strong understanding of partner business models, you will help partners turn innovation into sustainable growth and scale successful solutions across customers and markets.
 Leveraging technologies such as Microsoft Foundry, Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI Services, Azure SQL, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, and GitHub , you will drive the development of scalable, secure, and enterprise-ready AI and data architectures.
 We are looking for a senior technical leader who can connect technology with business impact -someone who challenges conventional thinking, influences strategic decisions, inspires technical teams, and helps shape the next generation of AI-powered partner businesses.
 Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
 Business Impact

• Drive Frontier AI Transformation: Act as a strategic technical advisor to senior partner stakeholders, helping partners evolve into Frontier Partners by adopting AI-first strategies, agentic AI solutions, and new business models. Connect technology innovation with measurable business outcomes, accelerating partner growth and customer transformation.

• Accelerate Data & AI Business Growth: Proactively identify and shape opportunities to increase Azure Data & AI consumption, drive adoption of Microsoft Fabric and Foundry, and expand partner-led customer reach. Collaborate across Microsoft sales, engineering, and partner organizations to accelerate pipeline creation, solution adoption, and sustainable business impact at scale.

• Influence Strategic Technology Decisions: Challenge conventional approaches, guide partners through complex architectural and business decisions, and translate emerging technology trends into actionable transformation strategies. Proactively address technical and business risks, including security, data governance, privacy, responsible AI, and operational resilience.
 Partner Specialization

• Build Frontier Partner Capabilities: Lead the technical transformation of strategic partners by developing their Data & AI practices, architectural capabilities, and technical readiness. Help partners establish differentiated AI offerings, agentic solutions, and scalable delivery models that enable them to compete and grow in the evolving AI market.

• Accelerate Solution Innovation & Specialization: Guide partners in designing and delivering secure, scalable, production-ready Data & AI solutions, leveraging Microsoft Foundry, Fabric, Azure AI Services, and modern cloud architectures. Lead architectural design sessions, technical workshops, and strategic customer engagements while accelerating relevant Microsoft Solutions Partner designations and specializations, including Frontier AI.

• Scale Repeatable Partner Solutions: Enable partners to move beyond individual projects and proofs of concept by developing differentiated IP, reusable architectures, industry solutions, and repeatable offerings. Collaborate with partner and Microsoft go-to-market teams to accelerate commercialization, customer adoption, and scalable revenue opportunities.
 Technical Leadership

• Lead with Technical Excellence: Serve as a senior technical authority and trusted advisor across Data & AI, combining deep architectural expertise with a broad understanding of cloud-native applications, security, and agentic AI. Influence complex solution architectures, challenge technical assumptions, and guide partners toward scalable, secure, and enterprise-ready implementations.

• Shape Technical Strategy & Innovation: Leverage market insights, partner feedback, and emerging technology trends to influence technical priorities, solution investments, and partner transformation strategies. Contribute to Microsoft's technical communities by developing reference architectures, accelerators, best practices, and innovative solution patterns that can be scaled across the partner ecosystem.

• Inspire, Mentor & Scale Expertise: Act as a technical thought leader and mentor, driving knowledge sharing, coaching, and technical readiness across Microsoft and partner teams. Lead cross-functional initiatives, engage with senior technical stakeholders, and represent Microsoft's technology vision through strategic partner engagements, industry events, technical communities, and thought leadership.

Qualifications
 Required Qualifications

• Extensive Technical Experience: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field and multiple years of experience in cloud technologies, Data & AI solutions, software development, solution architecture, technical consulting, or technical pre-sales or equivalent experience.

• Senior Technical Leadership: Proven experience in technical consulting, solution architecture, or technical pre-sales, with the ability to lead complex technical engagements, influence senior stakeholders, and translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions.

• Data & AI Expertise: Strong technical knowledge of modern data platforms, cloud-native architectures, AI services, and enterprise AI solution development, including experience designing and implementing scalable, secure, and production-ready solutions.

• Language Skills: Professional English proficiency and fluency in German, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and business audiences.
 Preferred Qualifications

• Deep Microsoft Data & AI Expertise: Advanced hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI Services, Azure SQL, Azure Cosmos DB, and related Azure data and application services. Strong understanding of modern data architectures, analytics, AI platforms, and cloud-native solution development.

• Agentic AI & Emerging Technologies: Experience designing and implementing generative AI and agentic AI solutions, including AI agents, orchestration frameworks, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), enterprise AI integration, and responsible AI principles. Ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into production-ready business solutions.

• Enterprise Architecture & Solution Development: Proven experience leading complex architectural design sessions, developing Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and Minimum Viable Products (MVPs), and transitioning innovative solutions into secure, scalable production environments.

• Partner Transformation & Business Acumen: Experience working with technology partners, system integrators, or enterprise customers to develop technical capabilities, solution practices, differentiated IP, and repeatable offerings. Strong understanding of how technology innovation translates into business value, customer adoption, and sustainable growth.

• Strategic Influence & Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior technical and business stakeholders, challenge existing approaches, and drive technical decisions across complex organizations. Experience mentoring technical teams, leading cross-functional initiatives, and shaping technical strategies.

• Competitive Landscape & Industry Trends: Strong understanding of the evolving Data & AI ecosystem, including hyperscaler platforms, emerging AI technologies, open-source frameworks, and competitive offerings from AWS, Google Cloud, and other AI platform providers.

• Customer & Partner Engagement: 10+ years of experience in customer-facing or partner-facing technical roles, with a track record of driving complex technical projects, accelerating technology adoption, and delivering measurable business outcomes.

• Technical Certifications: Relevant advanced certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700), or equivalent certifications from AWS, Google Cloud, or other recognized technology providers.

Overview
Shape the Future of AI. Transform Partners into Frontier Leaders. Scale Business Impact.
Join Microsoft's high-performing Cloud & AI Partner Architects team in DACH and play a pivotal role in accelerating AI innovation and business transformation across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland through our strategic partner ecosystem.
As a Senior Cloud Solution Architect - Data & AI , you will combine deep technical expertise, architectural leadership, and strategic business acumen to help our most influential partners design, build, and scale innovative AI-powered solutions. You will act as a trusted technical advisor, guiding partners through complex architectural decisions, solution development, and the adoption of Microsoft's latest cloud, data, and AI technologies.
A key part of your mission is to accelerate the evolution of our partners into Frontier Partners -helping them move beyond traditional technology services and isolated AI experiments toward AI-first business models, intelligent agent-based solutions, differentiated intellectual property (IP), and scalable, repeatable offerings that deliver measurable customer outcomes.
You will work closely with partner executives, technical leaders, engineering teams, and Microsoft sales organizations to shape AI transformation strategies, lead architectural design sessions, accelerate production-ready solutions, and unlock new market opportunities . By combining technical leadership with a strong understanding of partner business models, you will help partners turn innovation into sustainable growth and scale successful solutions across customers and markets.
Leveraging technologies such as Microsoft Foundry, Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI Services, Azure SQL, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, and GitHub , you will drive the development of scalable, secure, and enterprise-ready AI and data architectures.
We are looking for a senior technical leader who can connect technology with business impact -someone who challenges conventional thinking, influences strategic decisions, inspires technical teams, and helps shape the next generation of AI-powered partner businesses.
Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
Business Impact

• Drive Frontier AI Transformation: Act as a strategic technical advisor to senior partner stakeholders, helping partners evolve into Frontier Partners by adopting AI-first strategies, agentic AI solutions, and new business models. Connect technology innovation with measurable business outcomes, accelerating partner growth and customer transformation.

• Accelerate Data & AI Business Growth: Proactively identify and shape opportunities to increase Azure Data & AI consumption, drive adoption of Microsoft Fabric and Foundry, and expand partner-led customer reach. Collaborate across Microsoft sales, engineering, and partner organizations to accelerate pipeline creation, solution adoption, and sustainable business impact at scale.

• Influence Strategic Technology Decisions: Challenge conventional approaches, guide partners through complex architectural and business decisions, and translate emerging technology trends into actionable transformation strategies. Proactively address technical and business risks, including security, data governance, privacy, responsible AI, and operational resilience.
Partner Specialization

• Build Frontier Partner Capabilities: Lead the technical transformation of strategic partners by developing their Data & AI practices, architectural capabilities, and technical readiness. Help partners establish differentiated AI offerings, agentic solutions, and scalable delivery models that enable them to compete and grow in the evolving AI market.

• Accelerate Solution Innovation & Specialization: Guide partners in designing and delivering secure, scalable, production-ready Data & AI solutions, leveraging Microsoft Foundry, Fabric, Azure AI Services, and modern cloud architectures. Lead architectural design sessions, technical workshops, and strategic customer engagements while accelerating relevant Microsoft Solutions Partner designations and specializations, including Frontier AI.

• Scale Repeatable Partner Solutions: Enable partners to move beyond individual projects and proofs of concept by developing differentiated IP, reusable architectures, industry solutions, and repeatable offerings. Collaborate with partner and Microsoft go-to-market teams to accelerate commercialization, customer adoption, and scalable revenue opportunities.
Technical Leadership

• Lead with Technical Excellence: Serve as a senior technical authority and trusted advisor across Data & AI, combining deep architectural expertise with a broad understanding of cloud-native applications, security, and agentic AI. Influence complex solution architectures, challenge technical assumptions, and guide partners toward scalable, secure, and enterprise-ready implementations.

• Shape Technical Strategy & Innovation: Leverage market insights, partner feedback, and emerging technology trends to influence technical priorities, solution investments, and partner transformation strategies. Contribute to Microsoft's technical communities by developing reference architectures, accelerators, best practices, and innovative solution patterns that can be scaled across the partner ecosystem.

• Inspire, Mentor & Scale Expertise: Act as a technical thought leader and mentor, driving knowledge sharing, coaching, and technical readiness across Microsoft and partner teams. Lead cross-functional initiatives, engage with senior technical stakeholders, and represent Microsoft's technology vision through strategic partner engagements, industry events, technical communities, and thought leadership.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications

• Extensive Technical Experience: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field and multiple years of experience in cloud technologies, Data & AI solutions, software development, solution architecture, technical consulting, or technical pre-sales or equivalent experience.

• Senior Technical Leadership: Proven experience in technical consulting, solution architecture, or technical pre-sales, with the ability to lead complex technical engagements, influence senior stakeholders, and translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions.

• Data & AI Expertise: Strong technical knowledge of modern data platforms, cloud-native architectures, AI services, and enterprise AI solution development, including experience designing and implementing scalable, secure, and production-ready solutions.

• Language Skills: Professional English proficiency and fluency in German, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and business audiences.
Preferred Qualifications

• Deep Microsoft Data & AI Expertise: Advanced hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI Services, Azure SQL, Azure Cosmos DB, and related Azure data and application services. Strong understanding of modern data architectures, analytics, AI platforms, and cloud-native solution development.

• Agentic AI & Emerging Technologies: Experience designing and implementing generative AI and agentic AI solutions, including AI agents, orchestration frameworks, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), enterprise AI integration, and responsible AI principles. Ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into production-ready business solutions.

• Enterprise Architecture & Solution Development: Proven experience leading complex architectural design sessions, developing Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and Minimum Viable Products (MVPs), and transitioning innovative solutions into secure, scalable production environments.

• Partner Transformation & Business Acumen: Experience working with technology partners, system integrators, or enterprise customers to develop technical capabilities, solution practices, differentiated IP, and repeatable offerings. Strong understanding of how technology innovation translates into business value, customer adoption, and sustainable growth.

• Strategic Influence & Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior technical and business stakeholders, challenge existing approaches, and drive technical decisions across complex organizations. Experience mentoring technical teams, leading cross-functional initiatives, and shaping technical strategies.

• Competitive Landscape & Industry Trends: Strong understanding of the evolving Data & AI ecosystem, including hyperscaler platforms, emerging AI technologies, open-source frameworks, and competitive offerings from AWS, Google Cloud, and other AI platform providers.

• Customer & Partner Engagement: 10+ years of experience in customer-facing or partner-facing technical roles, with a track record of driving complex technical projects, accelerating technology adoption, and delivering measurable business outcomes.

• Technical Certifications: Relevant advanced certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700), or equivalent certifications from AWS, Google Cloud, or other recognized technology providers.

Gestalten Sie die Zukunft der KI. Transformieren Sie Partner in Frontier Leaders. Scale Business Impact.
Treten Sie dem leistungsstarken Cloud & AI Partner Architects-Team von Microsoft in DACH bei und spielen Sie durch unser strategisches Partner-Ökosystem eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Beschleunigung von KI-Innovation und Geschäftstransformation in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz.
Als Senior Cloud Solution Architect - Data & AI kombinieren Sie umfassendes technisches Know-how, architektonische Führung und strategischen Geschäftssinn, um unseren einflussreichsten Partnern zu helfen, innovative KI-basierte Lösungen zu entwerfen, zu bauen und zu skalieren. Sie fungieren als vertrauenswürdiger technischer Berater und führen Partner durch komplexe Architekturentscheidungen, Lösungsentwicklung und die Einführung der neuesten Cloud-, Daten- und KI-Technologien von Microsoft.

Als Mitarbeiter kommen wir mit einer Wachstumsmentalität zusammen, stärken andere und arbeiten zusammen, um unsere gemeinsamen Ziele zu erreichen.
